decor_source: SUPERSEDED DECLARATION -- the term is measured per execution block by decor_r13.py and quoted in Table 3 through sens_r11.py; this bracket is the external assumption it replaced
fluxcal_source: ALMA Proposer's Guide App. A.9.2, "Absolute flux accuracy" (Cycle 13 Doc 13.2 ver. 1.0, p. 48), corroborated by the ALMA Technical Handbook Sec. 10.2.6; where the two disagree (Band 8: 20 per cent in the Handbook Ch. 11 QA2 criterion against 10 in the Guide) the more conservative figure is adopted (EXTERNAL SPECIFICATION, not measured here)
point_source: ALMA Technical Handbook Sec. 10.3.3, "Antenna Pointing Accuracy" -- the relative fast-switching figure, not the all-sky one (about 2 arcsec RMS) (EXTERNAL SPECIFICATION, not measured here)
